title: Meeting-room booking calendar
issue: People can't book 11:00 right after a 10:00 meeting, quick bookings without a duration fail with a confusing error, and the weekly stand-up only shows up in its last week.

bugs.summary: overlaps() uses <=, so touching intervals count as overlapping.
start + duration || DEFAULT_DURATION parses as (start + duration) || 60, so a missing duration gives end = 60.
book() stores and mutates the caller's input object, and bookRecurring reuses one template, so every week becomes the same booking.
